description: This file defines the AdbInterface class, providing methods to communicate with an Android device via adb commands, including executing shell commands, pushing/pulling files, installing APKs, managing processes, and running instrumentation tests.

classes.name: AdbInterface
classes.description: Helper class for communicating with Android device via adb, providing methods for executing commands, managing files, and controlling device state.

methods.name: SetEmulatorTarget
methods.description: Direct all future commands to the only running emulator.

methods.name: SetDeviceTarget
methods.description: Direct all future commands to the only connected USB device.

methods.name: SetTargetSerial
methods.description: Direct all future commands to Android target with the given serial.

methods.name: SendCommand
methods.description: Send an adb command and return its output, with timeout and retry options.

methods.name: SendShellCommand
methods.description: Send an adb shell command and return its output.

methods.name: BugReport
methods.description: Dump adb bugreport to specified file.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Push a file from host to device.

methods.name: Pull
methods.description: Pull a file from device to host.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Install an APK on the device.

methods.name: DoesFileExist
methods.description: Check if a file exists on the device.

methods.name: EnableAdbRoot
methods.description: Enable adb root on device.

methods.name: StartInstrumentationForPackage
methods.description: Run instrumentation test for specified package and runner.

methods.name: StartInstrumentation
methods.description: Run an instrumentation class on the device and parse results.

methods.name: StartInstrumentationNoResults
methods.description: Run instrumentation and output to stdout without parsing results.

methods.name: PreviewInstrumentationCommand
methods.description: Get adb command string for instrumentation.

methods.name: PreviewShellCommand
methods.description: Get adb shell command string.

methods.name: _BuildInstrumentationCommand
methods.description: Construct instrumentation command string.

methods.name: _BuildInstrumentationCommandPath
methods.description: Construct instrumentation command string with path.

methods.name: _CreateTraceDir
methods.description: Create trace directory on device if not exists.

methods.name: WaitForDevicePm
methods.description: Wait for device package manager to be responsive.

methods.name: IsInstrumentationInstalled
methods.description: Check if instrumentation is installed on device.

methods.name: WaitForProcess
methods.description: Wait until a process is running on the device.

methods.name: WaitForProcessEnd
methods.description: Wait until a process ends on the device.

methods.name: _WaitForShellCommandContents
methods.description: Wait until shell command output contains or does not contain expected string.

methods.name: WaitForBootComplete
methods.description: Wait for device boot to complete.

methods.name: Sync
methods.description: Perform adb sync, handling remounts and restarts if needed.

methods.name: GetSerialNumber
methods.description: Get serial number of the device.

methods.name: RuntimeReset
methods.description: Reset the Android runtime without rebooting the kernel.
